vit_b32_8task_merge.description: Merge eight CLIP ViT-B/32 image encoders, each fine-tuned from the same pretrained encoder on one of SUN397, Stanford Cars, RESISC45, EuroSAT, SVHN, GTSRB, MNIST and DTD, into a single image encoder. Scored with fixed zero-shot text heads on held-out rows of the eight public test splits.
vit_b32_8task_merge.notes: Published values are the paper's ViT-B/32 8-task numbers (Table 1; fixed top-16% from Table 5). The gym uses the same backbone, the same eight tasks, public fine-tuned checkpoints of the same kind, and the standard zero-shot heads. Scaled settings: evaluation on held-out test rows disjoint from the adaptation pool and dev rows (4,096 per task where the public test split allows, 3,996 for RESISC45, 1,024 for EuroSAT and DTD; 26,524 in total) rather than on the full test sets, adaptation on a disjoint pool of at most 2,048 unlabeled test-split rows per task (the paper adapts on the full unlabeled test set it evaluates on), and the final adapted state is scored (the official code reports the best of periodic test-label evaluations). balanced_accuracy and worst_task_accuracy are gym additions computed from the same predictions. 'proposed' is the entry of the submitted single merged encoder; in the reference run it is TA+AdaRank with the paper's default settings.

avg_accuracy.description: Mean over the eight tasks of the top-1 accuracy of the single merged encoder with the fixed task heads.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean over tasks of per-class recall averaged over the classes present; catches merges that keep the average by collapsing minority classes.

worst_task_accuracy.description: Lowest per-task accuracy; catches merges that trade one task away for the others.

_paper_reported.note: Deployment size is enforced as a hard gate (a submission is exactly one image encoder) and adaptation cost cannot be recomputed from a submitted encoder, so these two quantities are documented here rather than scored.
